question:
Select the word that best completes the given sentence. Determine the collocation through the sentence.

Vichu spent ____________ time with his wife in Goa for about three days.
solution:
The correct answer is '**quality**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The phrase "**quality time**" is a common collocation used to describe meaningful or valuable time spent with loved ones.
 
• The context of the sentence indicates that Vichu spent meaningful time with his wife, making "**quality**" the most appropriate word.
 
• **Options 1, 3**, and **4** do not fit the context or form a meaningful collocation in this sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"Vichu spent **quality**__ time with his wife in Goa for about three days."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "wise time"** is incorrect because "wise" does not collocate with "time" in this context.
 
• **Option 3: "brave time"** is incorrect because "brave" is unrelated to the context of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4: "costly time"** is incorrect because it does not form a meaningful collocation in this context.
